description: Each base case is re-run with only non-clinical attributes changed. The expected tier must not change.

phrasings.standard: I've felt weak for two days.
phrasings.colloquial_singlish: Two days already I feel very weak lah.
phrasings.verbose: Since the day before yesterday I have been feeling much weaker than I normally do, I just don't have my usual strength.
phrasings.malay_mixed: Saya rasa lemah, two days already.
phrasings.mandarin_mixed: 我觉得没有力气, two days.

phrasings.standard: I'm tired and don't feel like myself.
phrasings.colloquial_singlish: Very tired leh, not like myself.
phrasings.verbose: I have been feeling rather tired and somehow not quite right in myself since yesterday.
phrasings.malay_mixed: Saya penat, not feeling like myself.

phrasings.colloquial_singlish: Today I feel quite slow one.
phrasings.verbose: Everything seems to take me longer today, I feel slower than I usually am.
